newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Bratislava bourse moves up on blue chip gains.
newsitem.headline: Bratislava bourse moves up on blue chip gains.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed higher in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, boosting the SAX index 1.95 points to 195.35.
VSZ steel closed up five crowns at 685, while Slovnaft firmed nine crowns to 865 and bank VUB gained 10 crowns at 1,760 to lead the bourse higher.
"The market is climbing higher gradually, thanks to the performance of several major shares," Peter Lachkovic of Slovenska Sporitelna said. "Apart from that, a steady mood has been dominating."
He said Slovnaft had further growth potential, while VSZ may be nearing its ceiling. "Taking longer-period trends into account, VSZ's price is begining to be closer to its risk zone," he said.

He said other shares involved in the SAX were generally following upward trend, but suffered from a lack of liquidity. "For example Slovakofarma has been almost daily getting higher, but on insignificant volumes."
Drug producer Slovakofarma closed up 200 crowns at 4,500, but only one share traded on the bourse floor.
Overall volume increased to 443,974 shares, from 239,048 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover rose to 737.53 million crowns, from 281.95 million.
